title: Profile plugin bundles replace the fixed surface overlays
summary: Every launch mode is a profile: a directory with a package.json that lists npm plugin dependencies and an ordered list of bundles, each bundle being an npm package that contributes a configuration patch, plus the user's own patch.
firstReason: Layered profiles and bundles are kept as configuration, but a bundle cannot be an npm package installed by pnpm; in Go a bundle is a named configuration layer over compiled-in components plus declared plugin processes.

title: What stays host-plane once presets own the agent plane
summary: After per-session agent presets took over model-facing configuration, services whose state is per process, such as the token meter, tasks and goals, stay in the host composition; entry points join agents to presets explicitly.
firstReason: The Go design needs the same line between per-process services and per-agent composition, whatever form presets take.

title: Declarative Agent presets and retained revisions
summary: An agent preset is ordinary loader configuration: an identity, display data and a list of child plugins. A registry owns each preset revision; running agents keep the revision they started with until they are disposed, and a preset that fails to activate stays listed but rejects new agents.
firstReason: Presets as loader configuration remove a second configuration system, and retained revisions let a preset be edited while agents run. In Go the child list names compiled-in components (DH-ADR-4), which fits the existing Go loader.

title: Headless jobs omit the interactive credential store
summary: The headless profile disables the stored-credential, authorization and account plugins. A headless job resolves keys only from its environment and `.env` files and never reads or writes the interactive credential file.
firstReason: A job sharing the harness home with a desktop user would otherwise run on that user's saved account instead of the key given to the job. It is a composition choice the Go headless profile repeats.
